claims: The 130th Boston Marathon was on April 20, 2026.
Kenya's John Korir set a new men's course record of 2:01:52 at the 130th Boston Marathon.
John Korir broke the previous 2011 record by over a minute.
Sharon Lokedi set the women's course record of 2:17:22 in 2025.
The wheelchair records are held by Marcel Hug with 1:15:33 in 2024.
The wheelchair records are held by Manuela Schär with 1:28:17 in 2017
